steps.content:
Eastside Streets
19:26

Every few meters, another massive Phanuel poster looms over the Eastside streets. The shopping mall's giant screen pulses with her MV clips, and the convenience store digital stands are stuck on a loop of her drink collab ads.
Joan cuts against the flow of pedestrians, pushing through this sea of pink with her terminal pressed to her ear, visibly annoyed.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: DisCity's laws are a joke. A bad one.
I agree. Otherwise, you wouldn't have slipped out of MBCC last night on forged documents, and I'd be out of this job.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: DisCity's lawyers are just as useless.
Now that, I'll have to push back on.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Oh, really. Those firms you sent my way are just as good as the MBCC at bouncing my case back and forth like a ball. Maybe they should quit practicing law and form a football team with the Bureau instead. They'd be great at it.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Lawyer A
steps.content: Ms. Joan, about the melodic similarity... well... the thing is, pop music relies on a pretty limited set of chord progressions. They overlap all the time. For a formal lawsuit, you'd need a detailed forensic musicology report first.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: So that's a no?

steps.speaker: Lawyer A
steps.content: Ah... we're very sorry. Cases involving this kind of specialized expertise are just... beyond what we can take on right now.
[Transition]

steps.speaker: Lawyer B
steps.content: Personally, I believe you, for what it's worth. Those two melodies... Honestly, I don't think that's a coincidence.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: You think you can win this?

steps.speaker: Lawyer B
steps.content: Thinking we can win and actually winning are two very different things. Mr. Fox sent you here, so I'll be straight with you.

steps.speaker: Lawyer B
steps.content: Phanuel is the biggest name in Eastside right now. Unless you've got something that'll destroy her in one shot... anything vague, anything that leaves room for doubt, her team will spin it. They'll paint you as a clout chaser trying to tear down a rising star.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Right. So you're not taking it.

steps.speaker: Lawyer B
steps.content: The safest move... is to wait. Let the concert hype settle. Then we can look at the landscape and figure out the next step.
[Exit Flashback]

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: I told you from the beginning. This case is unwinnable right now. Even if the Bureau let me walk out the front door, I probably couldn't pull it off.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: This isn't like the Anavrin case. Back then you had solid evidence, caught them with their hands in the cookie jar. Now? Your old tracks were posted on some indie forum that doesn't even exist anymore. Admin's gone. Account deleted... And your opponent happens to be the biggest idol in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: What, are you also worried about her fans coming after you? Please. Your name's already mud. One more stain won't show.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: ...I'm more worried about you, my old friend. The Bureau's figured out someone left the supervised zone without clearance. Notice just went out. Any Sinner who slipped out needs to report back by eight tonight. Otherwise, they're sending enforcement.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Tch... They take their sweet time on everything else, but one person goes missing and suddenly they're fast as lightning.
Joan checks the time. Thirteen minutes until the eight o'clock deadline. Yet she hangs up without a hint of concern, as if she isn't the one about to be forcibly taken into custody.
She tucks the documents proving she was plagiarized under her arm and is just about to head to the next law firm when a shout rings out from the street.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Don't walk past, walk on over! Phanuel collab merch, buy two get one free! Spend three hundred, get an exclusive fan sticker! And don't forget our mascot! Hit the follow button and the kitty'll throw you a heart!
Joan follows the sound to a pop-up stall crammed with Phanuel concert merch. The vendor bellows into a livestream setup with practiced zeal, and next to him stands a person in a cat costume.

The mascot's face is frozen in a dead-eyed stare. It rocks from side to side, one arm wrapped around a "Go Big, Phanuel!" placard. The other arm lifts stiffly, fingers bending into the most joyless heart gesture imaginable.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: God... That cat looks like it's dying inside. Fitting mascot for Phanuel fans, actually.
Joan shakes her head and steps around the cat mascot. But the costume's head suddenly swivels, its empty stare locking directly onto her.
The two stare at each other over a spread of fan stickers and glow sticks. Something hostile, undefined, prickles at Joan's senses. Frowning, she steps to the left.
The cat mascot steps left too, without missing a beat.
Joan takes a step to the right.
The mascot steps right immediately after.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Out of my way. I've had a garbage day and I'm not above fighting a mascot.
The mascot won't yield, no matter what she tries. It simply plants itself directly in Joan's way, those vacant eyes fixed on her, staring.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Sorry, sorry! Our kitty's a little too into the job today. Kitty, stop blocking the customer. That's coming out of your bonus.
The word "bonus" clearly strikes a nerve. The mascot hesitates, then pulls back half a step, and Joan seizes the opening to slip past the stall. But the very next second—
[Sound Effect: Alarm Ringing]

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Huh? What's that noise? Kitty, is that your alarm?

The mascot glances down at its terminal. The screen reads 20:00, along with a note: <color=#fb9259>Forced Detention Initiated!</color> In the next instant, the mascot produces a flashbang from somewhere unseen and lobs it directly at Joan's face.
Joan barely registers the object before her eyelid twitches—

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: What the ****? Are you a cat or a secret ops agent?! Kung fu cat?! What is happening?!

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Hey! Kitty! We don't use props like that! We run a proper livestream here, no dangerous stunts allowed—

Boom! The flashbang goes off before the sentence ends. Joan dives behind an advertising board on instinct alone. Screams ripple through the fleeing crowd. The vendor drops like a stone, bear-hugging a box of light sticks.

She's still gasping when the cat mascot lunges. Joan kicks a folding chair into its path, a desperate tripwire. The bulky mascot swerves around it in one clean sidestep, its movement as smooth as an FAC special operative.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: You're... pretty quick for a cat. Did Phanuel's people... put you up to this?

The costume crosses its arms over its chest in a large, deliberate X. Joan takes her chance, weaving through the maze of food stalls, using the flow of the crowd and the tangle of light stands to stay unpredictable.

The bulky mascot gives chase but gets wedged between the stalls after only a few steps. Without hesitation, it scrambles up onto the canopies, its massive cat-shaped silhouette darting swiftly across the high ground. Joan stares, utterly bewildered by this turn of events:

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Then who the hell ARE you?!

The mascot swoops down from above again and again, each time missing Joan by a hair as she uses the surroundings to stay out of reach. Still silent, it adjusts its approach and circles around to flank her, pausing only to point at Joan, then at the plaza clock, which reads eight o'clock sharp.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Can you just SAY something?! You're killing me here!

Before the words even settle, a bulky shadow engulfs her from above. No time to dodge. Joan acts on instinct; she reaches straight into the pounce, seizes the mascot's headpiece, and wrenches it upward.
Beneath the headpiece is another headpiece.

steps.speaker: Mascot
steps.content: The double headpiece is our stream's signature. Adds intrigue.
The mascot flips Joan to the ground and pins her, then pulls off the second headpiece.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: It's you?!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Unauthorized departure from the supervised zone. Forged exit paperwork... Ms. Joan, I told you not to do anything stupid.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Save it. Where's the pursuit order?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: There isn't one.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Then get off. I haven't laid a finger on a civilian. Haven't touched public property. No order, no enforcement. You've got no grounds.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: It's past eight and you're still out here. That's all the grounds I need. Big city, plenty of opportunities for someone who plans ahead. I figure Adjutant Nightingale will be generous when I bring you in.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: There... there you are! Finally!
By the time the vendor arrives, out of breath, the two of them have already traded a dozen blows.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: OH NOOOO! ...The camera. The stream's... still running? I'm doomed...
The chat is exploding, every second of the chase and the mask reveal caught in unforgiving detail.
Joan's interest is piqued by the vendor's howl of despair; she drives a foot into the mascot's soft belly and wrenches herself free.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: How many people are watching right now?

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: About three hundred before. Now... fifty-eight hundred?! No, sixty-two hundred?! It's still climbing! Sorry, guys! That was not supposed to happen. We're not usually like this, I promise! We're just gonna sign off for a bit and clean up... Feel free to give us a follow in the meantime—hey!
The vendor reaches to shut off the equipment, but Joan slaps his hand aside, snatches it, and trains the camera on herself.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Everyone still watching? That was just the warm-up. Stick around. I've got something better!
Joan whips out her guitar and straps it across her chest.

steps.speaker: Joan
steps.content: Fun fact for all of you: Phanuel, Eastside's biggest star? She's a thief!

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Miss! If you've got a death wish, leave my channel out of it! Don't say that kind of stuff on my stream—!
Jane watches the number skyrocketing on the backend screen and falls silent for a moment. Then she simply produces tape and rope from below the stall and makes her way over to the vendor.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Wait. Kitty. Good kitty. What are you—mmph! Mmph!

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Temporary risk control. You'll get a cut. Plus compensation for the tying-up part.

Jane ties the vendor to a chair and slaps tape over his mouth, then adjusts the hastily positioned tripod so the frame captures Joan perfectly, with Phanuel's advertising screen glowing right behind her.
As the livestream continues, the trending topics across Eastside's network keep updating in real time:
